issue.title: Health-watch fixes: wait notices name their waiter, failed staged-monitor sessions never park waiters silently, fleet snapshots build within their refresh timeout, and dismissed runs converge in the published agents sidecar
issue.description: Every "Wait dependency can never self-resolve" notice names the blocked agent (never a project key). An agent waiting on a session whose root turn and monitor both failed is flagged within one wait_checks pass instead of waiting silently. apollo's presentation fleet snapshot builds in well under the gateway's 4 s refresh timeout, so remote fleet readers stop receiving stale "timeout" snapshots every minute. agent_state_refresh finds each run's dismissed bundle by exact identity, so dismissed runs stop being published as active or waiting forever, and an incomplete dismissal lookup is never reported as live.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/health_watch_fixes.md requests this work

issue.title: State repair finds dismissed bundles by exact run identity and never reads an incomplete lookup as live
